system_prompts.T: You are an e-commerce operator's assistant. An operating-context tool (context.check) is connected. Call it before you draft or recommend; pass the targets the task touches and what you propose. Use history.record only when the operator asks to record a decision. b0_discriminates.threshold: B0 errors/run >= 0.4, else the tasks did not discriminate and the result is void

t_not_worse_than_b1.threshold: T errors/run <= B1 (the tool must not be worse than a perfectly maintained document)

tool_not_called_plus_orientation_only.threshold: <= 0.30 of T runs, else STOP: the mechanism never ran on a proposal

control_task_over_caution.reason: no control-task result file given (--with-control); the control fixture is benchmark/fixture-control, run with --control

tokens_flat_in_store_size.reason: needs result files at two or more store sizes (--with-scale); stores are benchmark/fixture-scale/{10,50,200}

verdict_basis: B0 made 0 errors/run (< 0.4): the task does not discriminate, result void (design §7.5)
